tiers.req: First trinket equipped (trinkets drop only while an event runs; event dungeons open at character level 50).
A trinket on each character you play with the main stat the Trinket by role table gives for its role.
The trinket on your Pusher at its max level.
A max-level Legendary trinket reforged with the two stats you want guaranteed.

tables.title: Trinket rules
rows: Added in 0.321.0: an item for the one trinket slot, with a main stat and up to four sub-stats. Trinkets drop only while an event runs, from every tier of its dungeons, with a bonus for running solo. The event shop, monthly and login rewards have none, so they can be missed between events.
Dungeon tiers are gated by attack; the top tier needs 10M since 0.323.1, and zone-bound bonuses such as the Bonfire's heated-zone attack no longer count.

HP, ATK, Gold %, All EXP %, mining power or woodcutting power. Each event has four pieces of rising size, and the main stat's size follows the piece and its level (Trinket pieces). All EXP also covers mining and woodcutting XP. The main stat cannot be rerolled.

Two trinkets with the same stat but different values are different pieces or levels. Bountiful Tusk, Generous Cornucopia and Plentiful Bihorn start at 20, 30 and 40 mining power and gain with level, so a level 5 Cornucopia shows 40. Keep the largest piece for each stat and feed the rest into it.

There are 12: Offline Gains %, Drop Quantity, crit chance, crit damage, MEN, CON, STR, DEX, INT, HP %, mining power % and woodcutting power %. Only some roll active (white): 0-1 / 1-2 / 2-3 / 3-4 on a Black Candle / Candlestick / Candelabra / Luminor and their Harvest sizes; the rest are greyed. A sub-stat starts at its base, on a Luminor +1% Offline Gains or +2 Drop Quantity, and every third trinket level one random sub-stat, possibly a greyed one, gains a step; reaching a Luminor's maximum can take all five of its steps on one sub-stat (see Luminor maxima). Which ones to want depends on the role: see Trinket by role.
Community tables disagree: Drop Quantity 10-12 at max, crit damage 35% to 40%, STR, DEX or INT 20 to 25 (AlexG: 10, 40%, 25; Stratasys: 12, 35%, 20). Neither is game data.

There is one trinket slot, and presets switch runes and curios but not trinkets. Put the ATK or HP trinket on by hand for bosses, the tower and dungeons, and the farming one back on before you park the character.

An Upgrade Flask is 10 XP; other trinkets can be fed in too, a Black Candle / Candlestick / Candelabra / Luminor size giving 120 / 200 / 400 / 600 XP. Flasks are spent first. Disassembling gives 12 / 20 / 40 / 60 flasks for those sizes, and returns the material spent on levelling minus 20%.
Since 0.323.0 any trinket can be reforged with Reforge Feathers, and a max-level Legendary can lock up to two stats for guaranteed upgrades; you may keep the old layout.
Harvest dungeons (to December 2) drop Bountiful Tusk, Generous Cornucopia, Plentiful Bihorn and Abundant Overgrowth.

tables.title: Trinket by role
rows: ATK; HP instead for a boss that kills you, which matters little in solo event dungeons, where you revive
Bosses, the tower and dungeons. Presets do not switch trinkets, so swap it on by hand before the fight.
Offline Gains, then Drop Quantity, crit chance, class stat (Soso, for a parked farmer)
While it farms, parked or online
Drop Quantity, then Offline Gains. Soso's order for an active farmer: a Rogue Drop Quantity > MEN > crit damage > crit chance > DEX; a Warrior the same with STR; a Mage the same without MEN
While it opens boss chests and farms cards. Drop Quantity is only a sub-stat and counts only for boss chests and cards.
Mining or woodcutting power, matching its skill, until its power is capped, then All EXP (Soso); All EXP also covers gathering XP
Offline Gains, then Drop Quantity, mining or woodcutting power %, STR for mining or DEX for woodcutting (Soso)
Its farming stat: All EXP, or a gatherer's power
While parked. A pusher swaps its ATK trinket for the farming one before it logs off.
Soso's pick for a combat farmer, active or parked, once it is damage-capped: Gold > All EXP > ATK. Below the cap, and for one Luminor worn for all content (All EXP > Gold > ATK), farmers keep All EXP
While a damage-capped combat farmer farms; otherwise filler until an All EXP trinket drops
